title: Thursday's ETF with Unusual Volume: PWV
text:
Thursday's ETF with Unusual Volume: PWV Thursday, January 25, 3:04 PM ET 10 Best Performing ETFs » The PowerShares Dynamic Large Cap Value Portfolio ETF (AMEX: PWV ) is seeing unusually high volume in afternoon trading Thursday, with over 1.1 million shares traded versus three month average volume of about 95,000. Shares of PWV were down about 0.1% on the day. 
Components of that ETF with the highest volume on Thursday were Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU ), trading up about 0.1% with over 32.8 million shares changing hands so far this session, and Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ), down about 1.7% on volume of over 27.1 million shares. Kimberly-clark (NYSE: KMB ) is the component faring the best Thursday, higher by about 2.5% on the day, while Ameriprise Financial (NYSE: AMP ) is lagging other components of the PowerShares Dynamic Large Cap Value Portfolio ETF, trading lower by about 3.5%. 
For MarketNewsVideo.com, I'm Sayoko Murase.
